battle.name: 762–763年阿里德起義
battle.brief: 公元762年，哈桑系阿里德兄弟先後在麥地那與巴士拉舉兵挑戰阿拔斯朝，翌年兵敗身死。卡面羅馬標槍屬共和末期工藝，與本役相隔八百六十餘年，不會出現在希賈茲與伊拉克的戰場上；當時阿軍以複合弓、投槍、長矛、劍與鎖子甲作戰。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場起義是阿拔斯王朝建立後第一次大規模的阿里德家族（哈桑系）叛亂，交戰的兩方是掌握帝國的哈希姆系阿拔斯政權，與拒絕承認其統治正當性的哈桑系阿里德。叛軍一方並無常備軍，也沒有獨立的行政機構：核心是穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉（綽號「純魂者」）與其弟易卜拉欣·本·阿卜杜拉兩兄弟，以及分布於帝國各地的阿里德同情者。麥地那一支靠安薩爾（Ansar，即麥地那與麥加的舊有家族）迅速加入而壯大，起義初起無一滴血；伊拉克一支則以庫法為傳統根據地的阿里德派，以及巴士拉、艾哈瓦茲、福爾斯與瓦西特的部落與城鎮支持者為主，起義者一度控制了艾哈瓦茲、福爾斯與瓦西特，點名冊（diwan）上寫到十萬人。阿拔斯一方是已經接管全部省份的國家機器：哈里發曼蘇爾（al-Mansur，754–775 在位）自以為尚未鞏固的革命此刻受到挑戰，於是從敘利亞與伊朗抽調部隊入伊拉克，以侄子伊薩·本·穆薩（Isa ibn Musa）為主將；麥地那方面則由總督里亞·本·歐斯曼與伊薩所部應對。第三方並非中立：侯賽因系阿里德拒絕參與，栽德系在政治目標與戰術上與哈桑系爭執不休，其餘阿里德各派多數按兵不動，只有口頭支持或出資相助。
countriesEn: This uprising was the first large-scale revolt of the Alid family (the Hasanid branch) after the establishment of the Abbasid dynasty, and the two sides in it were the Hashimite Abbasid regime, which held the empire, and the Hasanid Alids, who refused to accept the legitimacy of its rule. The rebel side had no standing army and no separate administrative apparatus: its core was the two brothers Muhammad ibn Abdallah, called 'the Pure Soul', and Ibrahim ibn Abdallah, together with Alid sympathisers scattered across the empire. The Medina column grew rapidly as the Ansar, the old families of Medina and Mecca, joined it, and the rising began without a drop of blood; the Iraqi column drew on the Alid partisans based in Kufa, the traditional stronghold of the cause, and on tribal and urban support in Basra, Ahwaz, Fars and Wasit, and the insurgents at one point controlled Ahwaz, Fars and Wasit, with a muster roll (diwan) of a hundred thousand names. The Abbasid side was the state machinery, which had already taken over every province: Caliph al-Mansur (r. 754–775), who felt the revolution he had led was not yet secure, drew troops from Syria and Iran into Iraq and put his nephew Isa ibn Musa in command; at Medina the task fell to the governor Riyah ibn Uthman together with Isa's column. The third parties were not neutral: the Husaynid Alids refused to take part, the Zaydi branch quarrelled with the Hasanids over political objectives and tactics, and most of the remaining Alid factions stood still, offering only verbal support or money.
people: 決定這場起義走向的是哈里發曼蘇爾·阿卜杜拉·本·穆罕默德。他 758 年逮捕了兄弟阿卜杜拉（因拒絕交代兄長下落），762 年初又擒獲穆罕默德與易卜拉欣的堂兄弟與姪子，把這些囚犯押往庫法嚴刑拷問，許多人死於獄中；正是這輪迫害把兩兄弟逼上絕路。曼蘇爾當時正在巴格達督造新都，聽聞麥地那起事反而如釋重負，說總算「把狐狸引出了洞」，隨即離開巴格達赴庫法，一面下令伊薩·本·穆薩率四千人進軍麥地那，一面以特赦相誘，又親自寫信勸降；穆罕默德回信重申自己出自阿里與法蒂瑪的血統，並批評改以專制王權為基礎的繼承安排，曼蘇爾則以穆罕默德時代男性親屬優先繼承的傳統作答。這些書信靠泰巴里保存下來，但顯然經過渲染。麥地那方面，純魂者穆罕默德於 762 年 9 月 25 日突然在城中舉旗，出其不意地拿下總督里亞·本·歐斯曼，隨後重挖「壕溝」舊塹，拒絕撤出聖城，最終於 12 月 6 日與約三百名支持者戰死，遺體被斬首，首級送交哈里發。巴士拉方面，易卜拉欣於 11 月 23 日遲了兩週才響應，起初連克艾哈瓦茲、福爾斯與瓦西特，兵冊達十萬之眾，卻在是否進攻庫法的問題上與自己人分裂。763 年 1 月 21 日，他在巴士拉與庫法之間的巴赫姆拉以約一萬五千人迎戰伊薩·本·穆薩，前鋒一度得手，但全軍崩潰，統帥重傷被救走，2 月 14 日傷重不治。
peopleEn: The man who decided the course of the uprising was Caliph al-Mansur, Abu Ja'far Abd Allah ibn Muhammad. In 758 he arrested the brothers' brother Abdallah for refusing to reveal their whereabouts, and in early 762 he seized their cousins and nephews, had them taken to Kufa and put them to the torture, and many of them died in custody; it was that round of persecution that drove the two brothers to the point of no return. Al-Mansur was at the time supervising the building of the new capital at Baghdad, and the news of the rising in Medina came to him as a relief: at last he had 'enticed the fox out of its hole'. He left Baghdad for Kufa, ordered Isa ibn Musa to march on Medina with four thousand men, and at the same time offered an amnesty and wrote personally to call for surrender; Muhammad answered by restating his descent from Ali and Fatima and by denouncing the absolutist monarchical arrangement, and al-Mansur replied by invoking the pre-Islamic tradition of inheritance, which gave priority to a man's male relatives. The exchange of letters was preserved by al-Tabari, though doubtlessly much embellished. On the Medina side, the Pure Soul Muhammad raised his banner in the city on 25 September 762, took the governor Riyah ibn Uthman by surprise, and then re-dug the old trench, refusing to abandon the holy city; he finally fell fighting on 6 December with some three hundred of his followers, and his body was beheaded and the head carried back to the caliph. On the Basra side, Ibrahim waited two weeks longer before rising on 23 November; he seized Ahwaz, Fars and Wasit with a muster of a hundred thousand names, only to split with his own people over the question of whether to march on Kufa. On 21 January 763 he met Isa ibn Musa at Bakhamra, on the road between Basra and Kufa, with some fifteen thousand men; his vanguard had the better of the opening, but the army collapsed, he was carried off badly wounded, and he died of his wounds on 14 February.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍（pilum）是共和末期羅馬軍的標準投射兵器：半米長的投槍，槍幹中空，鐵製槍頭連著一段軟鐵頸，命中盾牌後頸部即折斷，敵人往往只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。它成形於公元前 1 世紀，與 762 年的希賈茲和伊拉克相隔八百六十餘年，不可能出現在本役的戰場上；八世紀的阿拉伯軍隊既沒有這種制式投槍，也沒有能成排齊射的紀律。其功能上的對應物是投標槍與刺槍：阿拉伯語軍事文獻中常見的投槍以木桿配鐵矛頭，尾端常帶鐵刺，落地之後多可取回再擲，與 pilum「一擊即折」的設計取向恰好相反；近身則靠長矛（刺槍）、單刃直刀與弧刃彎刀，遠程靠早於此時已在阿拉伯半島使用的複合弓，以角、筋、木三種材料製成，是後來伊斯蘭世界複合反曲弓的先型。防護上，阿拔斯軍以鎖子甲（dirac）配小圓盾，部落軍則多披皮甲或鱗甲；雙方都有大量旗幟、鼓與槍標，靠聲光維持陣線與士氣。攻城與野戰工具方面，本役幾乎沒有攻城器械的記載：麥地那攻防靠的是把 627 年「壕溝戰」時挖的舊塹重新挖深，以及阿拔斯軍把門板鋪在壕溝上作臨時通道；真正發揮決定作用的不是器械，而是後勤封鎖——切斷自埃及運往麥地那的糧食。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card was the standard missile of the late Republican Roman army: a half-metre javelin with a hollow shaft, its iron head joined by a soft iron neck that snapped on impact, so that an enemy struck in the shield could only withdraw behind his cover with half the weapon still in his hand. It belongs to the first century BC and stands some eight hundred and sixty years away from the Hejaz and Iraq of 762, so it cannot have been present in this campaign; the Arab armies of the eighth century had neither that standard missile nor the discipline to loose it in ranks. Its functional counterparts are the thrown javelin and the thrusting spear: the javelins known from Arabic military literature have a wooden shaft with an iron head and often an iron butt-spike, and they can generally be picked up and thrown again, which is the exact opposite of the pilum's design logic of breaking after one strike; at close quarters the men relied on the long thrusting spear, on single-edged straight swords and on curved sabres, and at range on the composite bow already used in Arabia before this time, built from horn, sinew and wood, the ancestor of the composite recurve bow of the later Islamic world. For protection, the Abbasid troops wore mail (dirac) with small round shields, while the tribal contingents went into the line in leather or scale armour; both sides carried a great many banners, drums and spear standards, keeping the line and its morale together by sight and sound. As for siege and field equipment, the campaign leaves almost no record of siege engines: the defence of Medina rested on re-digging the old trench cut for the Battle of the Trench in 627 and on the Abbasids laying doors across the ditch as a temporary crossing; what actually decided the matter was not machinery but a logistical blockade, the cutting off of the grain that came to Medina from Egypt.
tactics: 起義者的戰術問題不在火力，而在組織與地理選擇。麥地那一支占據的是象徵價值極高、戰略價值極低的聖城：曼蘇爾第一時間就切斷自埃及運來的糧食，而阿拔斯軍沒有急著強攻，只是駐紮在壕溝外，屢次以特赦招降；純魂者重挖舊塹，據城死守，等的是庫法方面的阿里德派舉兵來援，結果援兵從未成軍。等到守軍望風披靡、士氣崩落，伊薩·本·穆薩才下令在壕溝上鋪門板突入，巷戰之後守軍約三百人全滅。伊拉克一支的戰術則是短暫的連鎖擴張：先取艾哈瓦茲，再控制福爾斯與瓦西特，把南部伊拉克的稅源與兵源收進版圖，點名冊號稱十萬；但庫法的阿里德舊部主張直取庫法，巴士拉本地勢力則傾向就地議和或按兵不動，兩種意見在行軍途中僵持，軍隊在兩城之間的巴赫姆拉停下。763 年 1 月 21 日那場決戰因此不是攻城戰而是野戰：起義軍先擊潰阿拔斯前鋒，隨即因大量脫隊與援軍未至而崩潰，被阿拔斯主力合圍，統帥重傷，僅帶數人逃出。阿拔斯的核心手法是：以時間換取集結、以特赦分化敵人、以封鎖斷糧，最後才投入決戰兵力。
tacticsEn: The tactical problem of the insurgents lay not in firepower but in organisation and in the choice of ground. The Medina column occupied a city of very high symbolic value and very low strategic value: al-Mansur cut off the grain coming from Egypt at the first opportunity, and the Abbasid army did not hurry to storm the walls but sat in front of the trench, offering an amnesty again and again; the Pure Soul re-dug the old ditch, held the city, and waited for the Alid partisans of Kufa to rise, and that relief never came. Once the defenders began to desert and the garrison's nerve broke, Isa ibn Musa ordered doors laid across the ditch and the city entered; after the street fighting some three hundred of the defenders were left dead. The Iraqi column's tactic was a brief chain of expansion: it took Ahwaz first, then Fars and Wasit, drawing the revenue and the manpower of southern Iraq into the insurgents' camp, with a muster roll of a hundred thousand names; but the old Alid partisans of Kufa urged a direct march on Kufa, while the local Basran notables preferred a negotiated settlement in place or simply to sit still, and the argument deadlocked on the march, so the army halted at Bakhamra between the two cities. The decisive engagement of 21 January 763 was therefore not a siege but a field battle: the insurgents beat the Abbasid vanguard, and then broke as desertions multiplied and no reinforcements came, being enveloped by the Abbasid main body, the commander being wounded and escaping with only a handful of men. The core of the Abbasid method was to buy time for concentration, to divide the enemy with offers of amnesty, and to starve them by cutting the supply, and only then to commit the force that decided the battle.
data: 有根據可寫的數字如下。時間線極為明確：762 年 9 月 25 日純魂者在麥地那宣布起義；11 月 23 日易卜拉欣在巴士拉宣布，比其兄遲了整整兩週；12 月 6 日麥地那陷落，純魂者陣亡；763 年 1 月 21 日巴赫姆拉之戰；2 月 14 日易卜拉欣因傷身亡，起義至此結束。麥地那自 9 月 25 日被圍到 12 月 6 日陷落，抵抗約七十日。兵力方面，阿拔斯軍攻麥地那的四千人由伊薩·本·穆薩率領；麥地那陷落時與純魂者戰死的支持者約三百人。易卜拉欣一方的名冊（diwan）號稱十萬人，但開戰前已大量脫逃，到巴赫姆拉時據記載只剩約一萬五千人。地理尺度上，麥地那距麥加約四百五十公里，麥地那至庫法的直線距離約一千四百公里，兩支起義軍之間隔着這樣一段路程，因此事後幾乎不可能互相支援；巴士拉至庫法約一百數十公里，巴赫姆拉就在這段道路上。數字之外的空白也要說明：本役沒有留下雙方總兵力、攻城器械數量與傷亡總數的可靠統計，關於巴士拉方向最終投入的軍力，只能從「名冊十萬」與「戰時一萬五千」這組落差推知內部瓦解的程度。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are these. The chronology is very clear: on 25 September 762 the Pure Soul declared the rising at Medina; on 23 November Ibrahim declared himself at Basra, exactly two weeks after his brother; on 6 December Medina fell and the Pure Soul was killed; the battle of Bakhamra was fought on 21 January 763; on 14 February Ibrahim died of his wounds and the uprising was over. From the investment of Medina on 25 September to its fall on 6 December the resistance lasted about seventy days. On strength: the four thousand men with whom Isa ibn Musa attacked Medina were under his own command, and some three hundred of the defenders of Medina fell with the Pure Soul when the city fell. The roll (diwan) of Ibrahim's side was said to number a hundred thousand names, but a great many had already slipped away before the fighting began, and by the time of Bakhamra the record puts the force he had with him at some fifteen thousand. In terms of distances: Medina is about four hundred and fifty kilometres from Mecca, and the direct line from Medina to Kufa is about one thousand four hundred kilometres; the two columns were separated by a stretch like that and could therefore scarcely support one another once the rising was under way; Basra and Kufa are a hundred and some tens of kilometres apart, and Bakhamra lay on that road. The gaps in the numbers must be stated too: the campaign left no reliable totals for the strength of either army, for the number of siege engines or for overall casualties, and the force actually committed in the Basra direction can only be inferred from the contrast between a roll of a hundred thousand and fifteen thousand men in the field, which shows how far the insurgents had disintegrated.
cause: 起因有兩層。表層是阿拔斯政權對阿里德家族的血腥逼迫。曼蘇爾即位後放棄了前哈里發沙法對阿里德「不予理會」的縱容，展開系統性追捕：758 年先捕阿卜杜拉，762 年初再擒一批堂兄弟與姪子，囚於庫法施以酷刑，許多人死於獄中，兩兄弟藏匿傳教、宣講的據點因而暴露，只能以舉兵自保。更深的一層是王權正當性之爭：阿拔斯家以「先知家族」整個哈希姆氏族為旗，自 744 年起便得到哈希姆派的支持，甚至一度以「先知家族中的一位被選者」（al-rida min Al Muhammad）為號召，奪權之後卻沒有兌現，反而扶植自己家族的成員；阿里德則堅持只有阿里與法蒂瑪的後裔才是正當繼承者，雙方的裂痕由此公開。此外，統治方在伊拉克已建立起更有效的軍政機器——庫法的常設總督府、敘利亞與伊朗的常備軍，以及受薪的奴兵（ghulama）體系；相較之下，此前未能佔據庫法、只能四處遊說的阿里德派在組織、經費與徵召上先天不足。這也是曼蘇爾敢於「讓狐狸出洞」、而兩兄弟只能以一次倉促的同時起事孤注一擲的結構性原因。
causeEn: The cause had two layers. On the surface lay the bloody pressure the Abbasid regime applied to the Alid family. After taking the caliphate, al-Mansur abandoned the tolerance of his predecessor al-Saffah, who had preferred to ignore the Alids, and began a systematic manhunt: Abdallah was seized in 758, and in early 762 a further batch of cousins and nephews were taken and imprisoned in Kufa, where they were put to the torture and many died; the hiding places where the two brothers had preached and proselytised were thereby exposed, and they could only answer by rising in arms. Beneath that lay a struggle over the legitimacy of the caliphate. The Abbasids had raised the whole Hashimite clan of the Family of the Prophet as their banner, drawing support from the Hashimiyya from 744 onwards, and had even campaigned under the slogan of 'a chosen one from the Family of the Prophet' (al-rida min Al Muhammad); having won the power they did not redeem that pledge but installed members of their own family instead, while the Alids held that only the descendants of Ali and Fatima were the legitimate inheritors, and the breach between the two claims was thereby made public. In addition, the government had by now built a far more effective military and administrative machine in Iraq: a permanent governor's office at Kufa, standing armies in Syria and Iran, and a system of paid slave soldiers (ghulama); measured against that, the Alid partisans, who had never held Kufa and had travelled from place to place preaching, were at a structural disadvantage in organisation, funding and recruitment. That is why al-Mansur could afford to 'let the fox out of its hole', and why the two brothers could only stake everything on a hastily launched simultaneous rising.
impact: 直接後果是血腥的清算。起義失敗之後，阿拔斯朝廷對阿里德展開大規模報復，逮捕、監禁與殺戮延續多年，許多在起義中保持沉默或僅出錢支持的人也被牽連，庫法與巴士拉的阿里德支持者網絡幾乎被連根拔起。從更長的視角看，這場失敗並沒有終結阿里德的訴求，反而讓阿拔斯王朝的權力得到鞏固，同時把「誰才是先知家族的合法繼承者」變成了一個無法靠一次起事解決、只能靠長期鎮壓與安撫交替處理的問題。曼蘇爾死後，其子馬赫迪（al-Mahdi，775–785 在位）一度改用懷柔，承認阿里德的地位，但這條路在 786 年「法赫赫之戰」後再度中斷；此後到馬蒙（al-Ma'mun，813–833）時，什葉派一方為解決王位繼承的合法性問題，甚至一度提名阿里·本·穆薩·里達為儲君，阿拔斯與阿里德兩家從此徹底決裂，十二伊瑪目派的框架亦在此後逐步成形。另一條線是流亡：穆罕默德與易卜拉欣的兄弟伊德里斯·本·阿卜杜拉逃往馬格里布，在摩洛哥建立 Idrisid 王朝，許多阿里德於是轉向帝國邊緣另立政權；這條在起義當年看似失敗的路，最終在西部伊斯蘭世界延續了三百餘年。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was a ruthless reckoning. After the rising failed, the Abbasid court launched a large-scale reprisal campaign against the Alids, and arrests, imprisonment and killing went on for years; many who had kept quiet during the rising, or had only given money, were dragged in, and the networks of Alid support in Kufa and Basra were very nearly torn out root and branch. From a longer view, the failure did not end the Alid claim, but it consolidated the power of the Abbasid dynasty, and at the same time turned the question of who was the lawful heir of the Family of the Prophet into one that could not be settled by a single rising and had to be managed by alternating long periods of repression and conciliation. After the death of al-Mansur, his son al-Mahdi (r. 775–785) briefly switched to conciliation and acknowledged the Alids, but that course was broken again after the Battle of Fakhkh in 786; later, under al-Ma'mun (r. 813–833), the Shi'a side, seeking a legitimate solution to the question of succession, even nominated Ali ibn Musa al-Rida as heir apparent, and the Abbasids and the Alids were from then on completely estranged, while the framework of Twelver Shi'ism took shape in the following decades. There was another line as well, that of exile: Idris ibn Abdallah, brother of Muhammad and Ibrahim, fled to the Maghreb and founded the Idrisid dynasty in Morocco, and many Alids turned to the remoter edges of the empire to set up states of their own; the road that looked like failure in the year of the revolt went on running for more than three centuries in the western Islamic world.
result: 結果是阿拔斯方面的完勝，而且來得比預期快。純魂者穆罕默德在麥地那的防禦以全城支持為基礎，卻輸在沒有糧道、沒有援兵：12 月 6 日城破，他與約三百名支持者戰死，屍首被斬，首級送呈哈里發；巴士拉方向，763 年 1 月 21 日巴赫姆拉一戰，起義軍先勝後崩，易卜拉欣重傷逃出，2 月 14 日不治身亡，起義至此全面終止。史家對此役的判斷相當一致：這不是一次被強敵壓倒的起義，而是一次被自身缺陷壓倒的起義——兩支起義軍分處相隔逾一千四百公里的兩個方向，事後根本無法互相呼應；伊拉克方面在出發前就為「直取庫法還是就地議和」爭論不休，等到真正需要決戰時兵力已流失大半；麥地那方面則把整場戰爭寄託在一支從未出現的援軍身上。起義失敗之後，阿拔斯王朝不但鞏固了統治，還藉清算阿里德鞏固了自身對伊拉克的掌控，阿里德的旗幟被壓入地下，直到曼蘇爾去世後才重新被高舉。
resultEn: The result was a complete Abbasid victory, and it came faster than expected. The defence of Medina under the Pure Soul Muhammad rested on the support of the whole city, but it lost on the absence of a supply route and of any relief: the city fell on 6 December, he died fighting with some three hundred of his followers, his body was cut up and his head carried to the caliph; in the Basra direction, the battle of Bakhamra on 21 January 763 went first well and then badly, Ibrahim was carried off wounded and died on 14 February, and the rising was completely over. The judgement of historians on this campaign is remarkably consistent: it was not a rising crushed by a stronger enemy but a rising crushed by its own defects. The two columns lay more than fourteen hundred kilometres apart, in opposite directions, and could not possibly support one another once things had begun; in Iraq the argument over whether to march on Kufa or to negotiate in place was fought out before the army had even set out, so that by the time a decisive battle was needed half the force was gone; and Medina had staked the whole war on a relief army that never appeared. After the failure the Abbasids not only consolidated their rule but used the purge of the Alids to tighten their own grip on Iraq, and the Alid banner was pressed underground, not to be raised again until after the death of al-Mansur.
